steps.title: Set up Directory Structure
steps.description: Initialize standard Android directory structure including assets and resource folders.

steps.title: Configure App Meta Data
steps.description: Create app-meta.json at the project root for package and app name declarations.

steps.title: Initialize Gradle Properties
steps.description: Enable AndroidX and specify JVM memory parameters in gradle.properties.

steps.title: Configure Project-Level Gradle Settings
steps.description: Establish settings.gradle configuring repositories for Google and Maven Central.

steps.title: Set up Project Build Script
steps.description: Define standard AGP version 8.3.2 inside the root level build.gradle script.

steps.title: Configure App Build Module
steps.description: Configure compilation SDK 34, target SDK 34, and dependencies inside app/build.gradle.

steps.title: Create Styles Theme
steps.description: Establish a full-screen Material style with no action bar inside styles.xml.

steps.title: Design WebView Layout
steps.description: Create the activity_main.xml layout referencing the full-screen interactive WebView container.

steps.title: Embed Game Engine Asset
steps.description: Convert and save the web-based game HTML into the local assets folder for local high-performance loading.

steps.title: Develop WebView Controller
steps.description: Configure WebView parameters including JavaScript, Dom Storage, local database storage, and custom clients inside MainActivity.java.

steps.title: Optimize Immersive Mode
steps.description: Write system UI logic inside MainActivity.java to hide status and navigation bars for maximum game immersion.

steps.title: Configure App Manifest
steps.description: Define internet permissions, orientation locks, and hardware acceleration in AndroidManifest.xml.

steps.title: Perform Manifest Namespace Verification
steps.description: Ensure the manifest references valid Android schemas to prevent compiler parsing exceptions.

steps.title: Building Neon Rush
steps.description: Perform full gradle build validation and compile the project into the final interactive APK.
